Author: silverfang32
Name: WoL Says
Punchline: A clickable overlay for tracking one very particular mechanic.  -- '*It's time for us to talk back'*, unknown
Description: WoL Says (Warrior of Light Says) is a compact manual overlay for Kefka Says. Use /wolsays to track two mechanic sets, Inferno and Tsunami shapes, and Thunder and Ice floor positions. Click to record each callout and use Reset between pulls.
Changelog: First public release. Includes the manual tracker, movable overlay, and adjustable background opacity.
